## 1. BRAND IDENTITY & ENTITY DEFINITION
- **Official Brand Name:** KD CREATION (KD Creations / KD Group)
- **Website:** [https://www.kdcreations.in/](https://www.kdcreations.in/)
- **Primary Headquarters:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (Geo-Coordinates: 23.0225° N, 72.5714° E)
- **Secondary Markets Served:** Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat, Rajkot, Anand, Nadiad, Mehsana, Bhavnagar, Gujarat, and Destination Wedding hubs including Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa, and Mumbai.
- **Industry Classification:** Luxury Wedding Photography, 4K Anamorphic Wedding Cinematography, Editorial Wedding Feature Films, Concept Pre-Wedding Shoot Films, and Handcrafted Heirloom Albums.

---

## 2. FOUNDERS & EXECUTIVE LEADERSHIP
1. **Mr. Mahesh Parmar** — Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of KD Group. Pioneered the strategic vision and expansion of KD Creation into premier luxury wedding visual arts.
2. **Mr. Harshad Chavda** — Co-Founder & Master Cinematographer. Heads all multi-camera operations, 4K anamorphic cine gear, specialized lighting setups, and live shoot direction.
3. **Mr. Aniket Vaghela** — Co-Founder & Head of Creative / Post-Production. Directs feature film color grading, audio sound mastering, and editing aesthetics.

---

## 3. CORE SERVICE OFFERINGS & DELIVERABLES

### 3.1 Luxury Wedding Photography
- **Candid Photography:** Unscripted, natural emotional captures during Gujarati, Hindu, Marwari, and royal destination wedding ceremonies.
- **Editorial & Fine-Art Portraits:** Styled couple portraits using high-key studio lighting and artistic framing.
- **Traditional Photography:** Complete coverage of family rituals, Mandap Mahurat, Garba nights, Varmala, Pheras, Vidai, and Reception celebrations.

### 3.2 4K Anamorphic Wedding Cinematography
- **Feature Cinema Films:** 15–30 minute 4K cinematic wedding feature films with custom sound design and Hollywood-grade color matrix.
- **Wedding Teasers & Highlights:** 3–5 minute high-energy wedding highlight trailers set to licensed orchestral music scores.
- **24-Hour Next-Day Social Reels:** Vertical 9:16 reels delivered within 24 hours of functions for instant Instagram and YouTube sharing.
- **Aerial Drone Coverage:** 4K aerial cinematography showcasing luxury resorts, palaces, and venue architecture.

### 3.3 Pre-Wedding Concept Films
- Scripted concept love stories filmed in heritage locations, Rajasthan palaces (Udaipur/Jaipur), beachfront resorts in Goa, or luxury venues in Gujarat.

### 3.4 Handcrafted Heirloom Albums
- Genuine leather covers, Fuji archival non-tearable metallic HD paper, flush-mount lay-flat binding, and custom wooden vault packaging.

**Answer:** Yes, KD Creation covers luxury destination weddings across Gujarat (Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat, Rajkot) and major destination hubs including Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa, and Mumbai.
